workItem.zh-CN: 类型化 TCP/权限/依赖错误
workItem.en: Typed TCP, permission and dependency failures

acceptance.zh-CN: 拒绝、超时、无路由、取消分别返回；权限不足不显示空成功
acceptance.en: Return distinct refusal, timeout, unreachable and cancellation reasons; never present a permission failure as an empty success.

workItem.zh-CN: 系统 resolver 与显式 DNS 分离
workItem.en: System resolution and explicit DNS queries

acceptance.zh-CN: VPN split DNS、IPv6 nameserver、.local、多网卡 fixture 与实机矩阵
acceptance.en: Cover VPN split DNS, IPv6 name servers, .local and multiple interfaces with fixtures and a real-Mac matrix.

workItem.zh-CN: Job runtime 与有界进程适配器
workItem.en: Job runtime and bounded process adapter

acceptance.zh-CN: 总 deadline、进程预算、取消、输出截断、退出清理贯通 GUI/MCP
acceptance.en: Enforce total deadlines, per-process budgets, cancellation, output truncation and exit cleanup with consistent GUI/MCP semantics.

acceptance.zh-CN: 旧 JSON 可验证迁移；磁盘失败/中断不破坏原数据；分页可基准测试
acceptance.en: Verify migration from old JSON; preserve originals on disk failure or interruption; benchmark indexed pagination.

workItem.zh-CN: 稳定外部身份与接口双栈模型
workItem.en: Stable external identity, interfaces and dual stack

acceptance.zh-CN: 同 remoteID 换 IP 保留历史；多 VRF/重复 IP 不误合并
acceptance.en: Retain history when a remoteID changes IP; avoid incorrect merges across VRFs or duplicate IPs.

acceptance.zh-CN: DNS 到 TCP 到 TLS/HTTP 结构化证据可恢复并导出
acceptance.en: Persist and export structured DNS to TCP to TLS/HTTP evidence; reopen a Case and rerun its checks.

workItem.zh-CN: Zabbix 指标时间窗与事件关联
workItem.en: Zabbix metric windows and incident correlation

acceptance.zh-CN: 告警前后窗口、单位、来源、采样间隔、空数据、权限、时差均可解释
acceptance.en: Explain before/after windows, units, sources, sampling intervals, empty data, permission failures and clock differences.

acceptance.zh-CN: ProxyJump、转发启停、主机密钥变化、恢复布局不执行命令
acceptance.en: Verify ProxyJump, forwarding start/stop and changed host keys; restoring the layout sends no commands.

workItem.zh-CN: ToolProvider 与 iperf3 纵向切片

acceptance.zh-CN: 缺工具、版本差异、两端正反向、时长预算、取消可验证
acceptance.en: Verify missing tools, version differences, forward/reverse endpoint measurements, duration budgets and cancellation.

workItem.zh-CN: MCP Case 快照与排障计划
workItem.en: MCP Case snapshots and diagnostic plans

acceptance.zh-CN: 作用域、预算、过期计划由执行层拒绝；schema 与 GUI 一致
acceptance.en: Reject out-of-scope, over-budget or expired plans in the execution layer; keep result schemas consistent with the GUI.

acceptance.zh-CN: 邻居、端口、来源、时间、冲突、陈旧边可解释
acceptance.en: Explain neighbors, endpoint ports, sources, timestamps, conflicts and stale edges.

acceptance.zh-CN: 大/损坏文件、分析取消、hash、敏感附件、保留规则可验证
acceptance.en: Verify large/corrupt files, cancellation, hashes, sensitive attachments and retention rules.

acceptance.zh-CN: 两类实际设备的 Capabilities/Get、TLS、断线、不支持模型可验证
acceptance.en: Verify Capabilities/Get, TLS, disconnects and unsupported models on two real device families.

workItem.zh-CN: 配置备份/diff 与只读设备驱动
workItem.en: Configuration backups, diffs and read-only drivers

acceptance.zh-CN: 两类 OS 配置可比；完整性和脱敏通过；默认不写配置
acceptance.en: Compare configurations on two OS families; verify completeness and redaction; configuration writes stay outside this task.

workItem.zh-CN: 实机互操作与正式发布 gate
workItem.en: Real interoperability and formal release gates

acceptance.zh-CN: 实际平台/设备、支持 OS/CPU、升级、签名、公证、Gatekeeper 有证据
acceptance.en: Record real platforms/devices, supported OS/CPU pairs, upgrades, signing, notarization and Gatekeeper results.

acceptance.zh-CN: 共享可变状态风险收敛；取消和并行 fixture 通过
acceptance.en: Resolve shared mutable-state risks module by module; pass cancellation and concurrent execution fixtures.
